scene.caption: Too many Red Bulls, one database fight, and a sunset render worth screaming for.
scene.imagePrompt: A tiny round diorama of a hackathon office at sunset: a crowded table by a big window, laptops glowing with a simple colorful 3D world, scattered Red Bull cans, a pizza box with cold slices on the floor, and small stylized teammates gathered around, one pair mid-argument. Warm orange sunset light spills across the room, deep blue shadows, a few excited figures cheering as the screen glows. All on one round base.
scene.title: Sunset First Render

scene.caption: Fog burned off, we biked the cliffs, and I'm sunburnt but so happy.
scene.imagePrompt: A round diorama of a seaside cliff town: two small stylized cyclists on a bike path above pale surf, a wooden wharf with a bread bowl of chowder on a railing, sea lions clustered on pilings barking, morning fog peeling away at the left edge into warm noon light over a blue bay. Bright overhead sun, crisp shadows, salt haze.
scene.title: Fog to Sunburn Santa Cruz

scene.caption: Missed the bus and flipped my umbrella twice, but a cat in my latte fixed the whole day.
scene.imagePrompt: A round base holding a tiny kitchen table beneath a slanted skylight streaked with rain, in blue-grey evening light. On the table: a steaming bowl of ramen with chopsticks and a latte cup with a cat drawn in the foam. By the door leans an umbrella flipped inside out, dripping a small puddle. Two small faceless figures sit and lean nearby. Wet dusk blues with a warm amber lamp glow.
scene.title: Cat in the Latte

scene.caption: Biscuit found a tennis ball, we split a burrito, and the wind sent us home to nap.
scene.imagePrompt: A round base holding a grassy hill sloping down to a city park. A small stylized figure sits beside a second figure with a halved burrito in foil between them; a tiny scruffy dog grips a tennis ball, refusing to drop it. Below, small figures toss a frisbee. Palm fronds bend sideways in rising wind, and a folded nap blanket waits nearby. Late morning sun, hazy gold light thickening to windy gray-blue shadows.
scene.title: Biscuit's Park Sunday

scene.caption: Eight of us, too much pasta, and a sparkler in the tiramisu, then guitar on the pier.
scene.imagePrompt: A long table on a tiny Italian patio, string lights strung overhead, eight small faceless figures leaning in, bowls of pasta and a tiramisu crowned with a lit sparkler. Behind the patio, the base curves into a wooden pier over calm bay water, a small figure with a guitar. Dusk light: warm amber bulbs against a deep blue evening sky, soft reflections on the water.
scene.title: String Lights and Sparklers

scene.caption: Eleven hours of reactions, then Jake's hot chocolate and a silent walk home through the snow.
scene.imagePrompt: A round base holding a miniature library study carrel lit by a green desk lamp, thick organic chemistry notes and a steaming mug of hot chocolate beside it. Tall windows behind show snow falling in blue dusk light. Outside, a tiny stylized figure walks home through fresh snow under a dark midnight sky, footprints trailing behind. Quiet, lamplit, cold blue and warm amber contrast.
scene.title: Eleven Hours, First Snow

scene.caption: Five stops, one weird metal pole, and Dad's tomatoes all the way down.
scene.imagePrompt: A round base rising into a steep dusty summit at first light, warm gold sun low behind it and cool blue sky above. On top, a thin leaning metal pole with two small stylized figures beside it, one gesturing downhill. Below, three tiny cows graze on a green slope. A red vinyl diner booth sits at the base's edge with a short stack of pancakes and a single ripe tomato on the table.
scene.title: Sunrise on Mission Peak

scene.caption: Ugly galette, perfect peaches, and Mom on FaceTime — the whole day tasted like summer.
scene.imagePrompt: A round base holding a small apartment balcony at golden hour: a paper bag spilling ripe peaches, a scored round sourdough loaf, three giant purple carrots, and a lopsided peach galette on a plate with a slice missing. A phone leans against the railing, a small figure glowing on its screen; a second small faceless figure sits in a chair with a fork. Warm low amber sunlight, long soft shadows, clear evening sky.
scene.title: Market Morning, Balcony Golden Hour
